Because `tidytracks` is built on the move 2 object, it is possible to use both packages together. 
There is some overlap in functionality, but both packages have different philosophies and grammar systems.


- we use the move2 object because ...

- tidytracks builds on this to add extra functionality with the goal of completing a workflow within 1 packagem on one object, however we use a different grammer and naming covention of functions

- we like this prefix tells you object the function works on and the object it produces
- move 2 used more 'traditional' `sf` grammar. 

Many of our functions are the smae as thise in move 2, but with our grammar system.
A few have bee reworked for speed.

It is up to the user to0 choose which philosophy they prefer.
